comment: NativeJAM in a GraalVM image. 'jni' registers the JNI binding (the default -Djam.native.binding=jni) - unregistered native methods fail at call time with UnsatisfiedLinkError naming the JNI symbol: mmJni/jam_mm, createJni, and createPfJni (the -Djam.native.parallelFor host-executor context). 'resources' embeds the bundled libjam so NativeLoader can extract and System.load it. 'foreign' (-H:+ForeignAPISupport is default-on in 25) registers every FFM descriptor NativeJAM creates: the jam_mm downcall for -Djam.native.binding=ffm; the ALWAYS-built task downcall TASK_FFM void(fn, begin, end, tid) and the jam_parallel_for upcall stub void(pool, n, fn, arg) behind parallelFor; and the load-time pack queries jam_pack_abi() -> jint and jam_pack_size(ctx, dtype, m, k) -> jlong (no JNI twins - FFM only).
